He is the son of former NCAA All-American, NBA All-Star and NBA Champion [[Juwan Howard]] (his [[List of Michigan Wolverines men's basketball head coaches|coach at Michigan]]) and has three older brothers who play or played [[NCAA Division I]] [[college basketball]]. He is also related to NBA players [[Jalen McDaniels]] and [[Jaden McDaniels]]. In high school, he won a [[Florida High School Athletic Association]] (FHSSA) Class 5A State championship as a freshman at [[NSU University School]]. As a junior he transferred to [[IMG Academy]], where the team made back to back runs to the high school national final four. He was both a [[Jordan Brand Classic]] and a Iverson Roundball Classic honoree/participant. ==High school career== Howard attended [[NSU University School]] for his freshman and sophomore seasons from 2018 to 2020, before transferring to [[IMG Academy]] for his junior and senior seasons from 2020 to 2022.{{cite web|url=https://twitter.com/JettHoward5/status/1262112113549606912|title=@JettHoward5 status update|accessdate=February 4, 2023|date=May 17, 2020|publisher=[[Twitter]]|author=Howard, Jett}}{{cite web|url=https://www.sun-sentinel.com/sports/highschool/basketball-boys/fl-sp-hs-howard-transfer-20200517-ite22xo5dvbnrj6himaslvy2qq-story.html|title=Jett Howard, son of Juwan Howard, transfers, fromUniversity School to IMG Academy|work=[[Sun Sentinel]]|author=Lichtenstein, Adam|accessdate=February 4, 2023|date=May 17, 2020}} His brother Jace played his junior and senior seasons with him for NSU University from 2018 to 2020.{{cite web|url=https://www.sportingnews.com/us/ncaa-basketball/news/juwan-howard-son-jace-howard-michigan/wvy8gtztqts7ler7nlqnc28u|title=Who is Juwan Howard's son? Inside Jace Howard's college basketball career at Michigan|accessdate=February 4, 2023|date=March 24, 2022|work=[[Sporting News]]|author=Sutelan, Edward}} The 2018–19 University team, which included [[Vernon Carey Jr.]], [[Scottie Barnes]] and [[Taylor Hendricks]] as well as the Howard brothers, successfully defended its [[FHSSA]] Class 5A State championship with a victory over [[Andrew Jackson High School (Jacksonville)|Andrew Jackson High School]], despite Carey being sidelined for the championship game.{{cite web|url=https://www.theledger.com/picture-gallery/news/local/2019/03/07/class-5a-final-university-72/66145967007/|title=Class 5A Final: University 72, Andrew Jackson 46|accessdate=February 4, 2023|date=March 16, 2019|work=[[The Ledger]]|author=}}{{cite web |last1=Lichtenstein |first1=Adam |title=University School — again with Carey sidelined — rolls to its second straight Class 5A state title |url=https://www.sun-sentinel.com/sports/highschool/basketball-boys/fl-sp-us-5a-sf-bhoops-20190307-story.html |website=[[Sun-Sentinel]] |accessdate=January 21, 2020 |date=March 7, 2019}} Howard participated in 3 [[USA Basketball]] Junior National Team minicamps as well as a USA U16 National Team training camp in 2018 and 2019. At IMG, Howard and teammates [[Jaden Bradley]] and Michigan Wolverine commit [[Moussa Diabate]] went to the 2021 Geico National Semifinals where they lost to Sunrise Christian Academy. Despite the loss [[Paul Biancardi]] of [[ESPN]] described Howard as "best shooter on the floor".{{cite web|url=https://michigan.rivals.com/news/michigan-basketball-diabate-howard-img-fall-short-in-national-semis|title=Michigan Basketball: Diabate, Howard & IMG Fall Short In National Semis|accessdate=February 4, 2023|date=April 2, 2021|publisher=[[Rivals.com]]|author=Balas, Chris}} With teammates [[Keyonte George]] and [[Jarace Walker]], Howard and IMG lost the 2022 National semifinals to the [[Dariq Whitehead]]-led [[Montverde Academy]].{{cite web|url=https://www.news-press.com/story/sports/high-school/2022/04/01/geico-basketball-roundup-semifinals-matchups-montverde-img-life-academy-prolific-prep/7203741001/|title=GEICO Nationals: Montverde downs IMG; Girls' final set between New Hope and Montverde|accessdate=February 4, 2023|date=April 1, 2022|work=[[Fort Myers News-Press]]|author=Maffezzoli, Dennis and Alex Martin}} Howard participated in the April 2022 [[Jordan Brand Classic]] despite being the 37th ranked player and 11th ranked player at his position in the National class of 2022.{{cite web|url=https://www.maizenbrew.com/basketball/2022/4/21/23033744/jett-howard-impresses-flashes-potential-at-jordan-brand-classic|title=Jett Howard impresses, flashes potential at Jordan Brand Classic|accessdate=February 4, 2023|date=April 21, 2022|publisher=[[SB Nation]]|author=Voss, Kellen}} By May 2022, Howard had slipped to the 40th slot in the National Class of 2022, but he excelled as the MVP of the [[Allen Iverson]] Roundball Classic despite the participation of 7 top-20 players (George, [[Cason Wallace]], [[Kel'el Ware]], Walker, [[Brandon Miller (basketball, born 2002)|Brandon Miller]], Arterio Morris and [[Anthony Black (basketball)|Anthony Black]]) on a 20-point 9-for-12 shooting performance. (cropped).jpg|thumb|upright|Howard with [[Michigan Wolverines men's basketball|Michigan]] in 2023]] Howard played his freshman season for the [[2022–23 Michigan Wolverines men's basketball team|2022–23 Michigan Wolverines]]. Michigan began the season on November 7, 2022, with a 75–56 victory over [[2022–23 Purdue Fort Wayne Mastodons men's basketball team|Purdue Fort Wayne]]. Howard contributed 21 points in his debut,{{cite web|url=https://mgoblue.com/news/2022/11/7/mens-basketball-dickinson-captures-1000th-career-point-as-u-m-defeats-purdue-fort-wayne-in-season-opener.aspx|title=Dickinson Captures 1000th Career Point as U-M Defeats Purdue Fort Wayne in Season Opener|first=Tom|last=Wywrot|access-date=November 7, 2022|date=November 7, 2022|publisher=[[CBS Interactive]]|website=MGoBlue.com}} becoming the first Wolverine to debut with 20+ points since [[Jamal Crawford]] posted 21, on November 19, 1999. In his first week of play, he earned Big Ten Freshman of the Week recognition for the week ending November 13, 2022.{{cite web|url=https://bigten.org/news/2022/11/14/general-michigan-sweeps-weekly-mens-basketball-accolades.aspx|title=Michigan Sweeps Weekly Men's Basketball Accolades|accessdate=February 4, 2023|date=November 14, 2022|publisher=[[Big Ten Conference]]|website=BigTen.org}} By early January, he was being mentioned as a future [[2023 NBA draft]] lottery pick.{{cite web|url=https://www.cbssports.com/nba/news/2023-nba-mock-draft-michigans-jett-howard-soars-into-lottery-after-fast-start-victor-wembanyama-goes-no-1/|title=2023 NBA Mock Draft: Michigan's Jett Howard soars into lottery after fast start; Victor Wembanyama goes No. 1|accessdate=February 5, 2023|date=January 4, 2023|publisher=[[CBS Sports]]|author=Boone, Kyle}}{{cite web|url=https://bleacherreport.com/articles/10060509-2023-nba-mock-draft-full-2-round-projections-at-the-new-year|title=2023 NBA Mock Draft: Full 2-Round Projections at the New Year|accessdate=February 6, 2023|date=January 5, 2023|publisher=[[Bleacher Report]]|author=Wasserman, Johnathan}} Howard posted a season-high 34 points on January 12, 2023, against [[2022–23 Iowa Hawkeyes men's basketball team|Iowa]], including Michigan's first 11 points and his first 5 [[three point shot]]s.{{cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap/_/gameId/401484888|title=Sandfort rallies Iowa past Michigan in overtime, 93–84|accessdate=February 4, 2023|date=January 12, 2023|publisher=[[ESPN]]|agency=[[Associated Press]]}} Howard was Michigan’s second-leading scorer with 14.2 points per game and led the Wolverines with 78 made three-pointers. Following the regular season, he earned All-Big Ten third-team recognition from the media and honorable mention recognition from the coaches as well as All-Freshman recognition from the coaches, marking the fifth consecutive season that Michigan has had an All-Freshman honoree ([[Moussa Diabaté]], [[Hunter Dickinson]], [[Franz Wagner (basketball)|Franz Wagner]] and [[Ignas Brazdeikis]]).{{cite web|url=https://mgoblue.com/news/2023/3/7/mens-basketball-dickinson-bufkin-howard-earn-big-ten-postseason-honors.aspx|title=Dickinson, Bufkin, Howard Earn Big Ten Postseason Honors|first=Tom|last=Wywrot|access-date=March 7, 2023|date=March 7, 2023|publisher=[[CBS Interactive]]|website=MGoBlue.com}}{{cite web|url=https://bigten.org/news/2023/3/7/general-2023-big-ten-mens-basketball-postseason-honors-announced.aspx|title=2023 Big Ten Men's Basketball Postseason Honors Announced: Purdue's Zach Edey named Big Ten Player of the Year|access-date=March 7, 2023|date=March 7, 2023|website=BigTen.org}} On March 23, 2023, Howard announced he would forgo his remaining eligibility and declared for the 2023 NBA draft.{{cite web|url=https://www.detroitnews.com/story/sports/college/university-michigan/2023/03/23/michigan-wolverines-freshman-jett-howard-declares-for-nba-draft/70043492007/ |title=Michigan freshman Jett Howard declares for NBA Draft |newspaper=[[The Detroit News]] |first=James |last=Hawkins |date=March 23, 2023 |access-date=March 23, 2023}} ==Personal life== Howard was born in Chicago on September 14, 2003, to Jenine and [[Juwan Howard]].{{cite web|url=https://www.usab.com/basketball/players/mens/h/howard-jett.aspx|title=Jett Howard|accessdate=February 4, 2023|date=July 9, 2021|publisher=[[USA Basketball]]}}{{cite web|url=https://mgoblue.com/sports/mens-basketball/roster/jett-howard/23514|title=2022–23 Men's Basketball Roster: 13 Jett Howard|accessdate=February 4, 2023|publisher=MGoBlue.com}} His father had a 21-year career in the [[National Basketball Association]] (NBA) before becoming the [[List of Michigan Wolverines men's basketball head coaches|Michigan Wolverines basketball head coach]] at his alma mater. He was an NCAA All-American as well as NBA All-Star and champion.{{Cite web|url=http://bigten.org/news/2019/5/30/mens-basketball-juwan-howard-named-michigan-head-coach.aspx|title=Juwan Howard Named |access-date=May 22, 2019 |date=May 22, 2019 |first=Tom |last=Wywrot |website=MGoBlue.com |publisher=[[CBS Interactive]]}} His half-brother, Juwan Howard, Jr. (son of Juwan Howard and [[Michigan High Juwan Howard and Tabatha Johnson), played four years (2016–20) for the [[Brown Bears men's basketball|Brown Bears]].{{cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/player/_/id/4066802/joshua-howard|title=Joshua Howard|publisher=[[ESPN]]|accessdate=February 5, 2023}}{{cite
